definitions.explanation: The contrast between strong and weak; varying degrees of power or force.
Variation in loudness or force, especially in music.

examples.english: There are variations in wind strength.

examples.japanese: ⟦{電波|でんぱ}→電波：04070_denpa⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{強弱|きょうじゃく}⟦によって→によって：06801_niyotte⟧⟦{受信|じゅしん}→受信：04896_jushin⟧⟦{状態|じょうたい}→状態：03345_joutai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{変|か}わる→変わる：00714_kawaru⟧。
examples.english: Reception quality changes depending on signal strength.

examples.japanese: ⟦{地震|じしん}→地震：01608_jishin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{揺|ゆ}れ→揺れる：01161_yureru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{強弱|きょうじゃく}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{場所|ばしょ}→場所：00829_basho⟧⟦によって→によって：06801_niyotte⟧⟦{異|こと}なる→異なる：02101_kotonaru⟧。
examples.english: The intensity of earthquake shaking varies by location.

examples.japanese: ⟦{音|おと}→音：00743_oto⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{強弱|きょうじゃく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦つける→付ける：00761_tsukeru⟧。
examples.english: To add dynamics (loud and soft) to the sound.

examples.japanese: {強弱|きょうじゃく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦つけて→付ける：00761_tsukeru⟧⟦{演奏|えんそう}→演奏：01896_ensou⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{曲|きょく}→曲：09881_kyoku⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{強弱|きょうじゃく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{変化|へんか}→変化：03615_henka⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{激|はげ}しい→激しい：02348_hageshii⟧。
examples.english: This piece has dramatic dynamic changes.

notes:
Compound of {強|きょう} (strong) and {弱|じゃく} (weak). Refers to the contrast or variation between strong and weak forces, intensities, or volumes.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {強弱|きょうじゃく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦つける→つける：00562_tsukeru⟧: to vary the intensity/dynamics
- {強弱|きょうじゃく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧: there is variation in strength
- {強弱|きょうじゃく}⟦{記号|きごう}→記号：00224_kigou⟧: dynamic markings (in music)
- {強弱|きょうじゃく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{差|さ}→差：02771_sa⟧: difference in intensity

MUSICAL USAGE:
In music, {強弱|きょうじゃく} corresponds to dynamics (forte, piano, crescendo, etc.). This is one of the most common contexts for the word.

SIMILAR COMPOUND PAIRS:
Japanese has many antonym-pair compounds: ⟦{大小|だいしょう}→大小：05557_daishou⟧ (large and small), ⟦{長短|ちょうたん}→長短：05558_choutan⟧ (long and short), ⟦{高低|こうてい}→高低：21533_koutei⟧ (high and low).
